configured_renderer:
; Original image scaled to a centered 4:3 borderless window.
; GDI avoids the graphics mode transition deadlock observed with D3D9.
[ddraw]
windowed=true
fullscreen=true
border=false
maintas=true
aspect_ratio=
renderer=gdi
savesettings=0
noactivateapp=false
singlecpu=true
maxfps=-1
minfps=5
lock_surfaces=true
